record_type_quote: The study described in the current report is a very close replication of Gray et al.’s (2011) study and had two clear goals. The first goal is to conduct independent close replications of the findings of the “body focus inducing redistribution of mind perception” effect as well as the “body focus inferring different moral statuses” effect.
